listing.name: Freeciv
listing.summary: Build a civilization and compete against computer or human opponents in turn-based strategy.
listing.download_block_reason: Choose the publisher’s installer or AppImage, or use a package manager that offers the current release.

steps.title: Open the GTK4 client
steps.instruction: On Windows 10 or later, choose the x64 GTK4 installer. On Linux x86-64, allow the GTK4 AppImage to run as a program and open it. On Apple Silicon Mac, install freeciv with Homebrew and run freeciv-gtk4.

steps.title: Start or restore a local game
steps.instruction: Choose Start New Game and then Start to play locally against the computer. Use Game → Save Game As to name and save your game. From the title screen, choose Load Saved Game, select your save, then choose Start in the lobby.

warnings: Back up your save files, settings and custom rulesets before updating or moving the game. Use the current release when opening saves or scenarios from other players.

references.title: Find saves and settings
references.instruction: The default profile is %APPDATA%/.freeciv on Windows and ~/.freeciv on Linux and Mac. Keep the full folder if you use custom data. Use your selected save location if you configured a different one.

references.title: Check other desktop builds
references.instruction: Homebrew publishes a Linux ARM64 package. For Intel Mac, see the upstream source build instructions and check your package manager’s current availability.
